description: A composite figure of three KAM (kernel average misorientation) EBSD maps plus one histogram, all for low-density Fe-28Mn-8Al-1C steel. (a) undeformed map with a 50 µm scale bar: almost uniformly dark blue, showing small local orientation differences, with thin dark grain-boundary traces outlining equiaxed austenite grains and a few isolated green/yellow speckles. (b) CR 30% map with a 20 µm scale bar: same microstructure more finely resolved, now mottled green and yellow with isolated blue and red pixels concentrated along the prior grain boundaries. (c) CR 90% map with a 5 µm scale bar: strongly heterogeneous, red and green elongated bands lying along the rolling direction alternating with blue bands, i.e. high misorientation inside rolling bands and low misorientation in the intervening grains. Each map carries a blue-green-yellow-red colour bar whose numeric values are not printed. (d) is a histogram with y-axis "Frequency" (0–3.5) and x-axis "Average angle/ deg" (0–5): the Undeformed distribution (orange) is sharply peaked below 1°, CR 30% (green) has a broad peak near 1–1.5°, and CR 90% (purple) is broadest, centred around 2–3°, with a small spike near 5°. Together the panels show KAM magnitude and spread increasing with rolling reduction.
measured_quantities: kernel average misorientation (KAM), colour-coded, unit not printed

observations.observation: Panel (a), the undeformed condition, is an almost uniformly dark-blue KAM map, indicating small local orientation deviations, with dark grain-boundary traces outlining equiaxed grains.
Panel (a) carries a 50 µm scale bar; panel (b) a 20 µm scale bar; panel (c) a 5 µm scale bar.
Panel (b), CR 30%, shows a green/yellow background with blue and red pixels concentrated along prior grain boundaries, i.e. elevated KAM near boundaries.
Panel (c), CR 90%, shows a banded, highly heterogeneous KAM distribution with elongated red/green bands along the rolling direction separated by blue bands.
Each KAM map includes a blue-green-yellow-red colour bar whose numeric KAM values are not printed on the figure.
Panel (d) plots Frequency (0–3.5) versus Average angle/ deg (0–5) for three conditions: Undeformed (orange), CR 30% (green) and CR 90% (purple).

In panel (d) the Undeformed distribution is sharply peaked at low average angle (below 1°), the CR 30% distribution is broader with a maximum near 1–1.5°, and the CR 90% distribution is the broadest, extending to about 5° with a spike near 5°.
The caption states the figure presents KAM maps of the test steel at different deformation degrees: a) undeformed, b) CR 30%, c) CR 90%, and d) comparison map of KAM.
The caption calls panel (d) a 'comparison map of KAM', but the panel is visually a frequency histogram of average angle rather than a map — caption and pixels disagree.
The citing text states that higher KAM values are seen near the prior grain boundaries after 30% CR, suggesting deformation concentration first occurs near grain boundaries.
At CR 90% the citing text reports higher KAM values in the rolling bands and lower ones in grains surrounded by LAGBs, and a significant increase of average misorientation versus the 30% condition.
The citing text reports boundary fractions for the same steels: 94.65% HAGBs for the undeformed condition, 89.4% LAGBs at CR 30% and 94.1% LAGBs at CR 90%.
The undeformed histogram peak lies below the 1° gridline, whereas the CR 30% peak falls between the 1° and 2° gridlines — no numeric peak values are printed.

subfigures.description: KAM map labelled (a), undeformed condition, with a 50 µm scale bar. The map is almost entirely dark blue (low kernel average misorientation) with thin dark grain-boundary traces delineating equiaxed austenite grains and only sparse green/yellow spots. A blue-to-red colour bar sits at the lower right without numeric labels.

KAM map labelled (b), CR 30%, with a 20 µm scale bar. Background is green/yellow (moderate misorientation) with distinct blue patches and red pixels concentrated along prior grain boundaries. Colour bar at lower right, values unlabelled.

KAM map labelled (c), CR 90%, with a 5 µm scale bar. Highly heterogeneous banded structure: elongated red and green (high misorientation) bands along the rolling direction alternating with blue (low misorientation) bands; original equiaxed grains no longer distinguishable. Colour bar at lower right, values unlabelled.

Histogram of KAM average angle: x-axis 'Average angle/ deg' from 0 to 5, y-axis 'Frequency' from 0 to 3.5, with three overlaid distributions — Undeformed (orange), CR 30% (green) and CR 90% (purple). Undeformed is sharply peaked below 1°, CR 30% is broader with a maximum near 1–1.5°, CR 90% is the broadest, centred around 2–3°, plus a narrow spike close to 5°.

unreadable_items: KAM colour-bar numeric values are not labelled on any of panels (a)-(c)
no numeric peak or mean values are printed on histogram (d)
